sloka: एवं ते ज्ञातिपक्षस्य श्रेयश्चैव भविष्यति ।यदि चेद्भरतो धर्मात्पित्र्यं राज्यमवाप्स्यति ॥२-८-३४॥
transliteration: evaṁ te jñātipakṣasya śreyaścaiva bhaviṣyati ।yadi cedbharato dharmātpitryaṁ rājyamavāpsyati ॥2-8-34॥

translations.english: If Bharata secures the ancestral kingdom righteously, it will bring welfare to you and to your relations also.
